title: AI Team Daily Standup — Aug 5, 2026
content:
AI Team — Standup Notes · Aug 5, 2026

Production
No new major production issues. Post-release quick-fixes to be completed today. The delayed Gia (J) responses feature is confirmed working in production.
Tickets are being moved from Code Review to QA Review so QA can start testing.

HIPAA compliance strategy (from Pushkar's R&D)
Avoid logging PHI/EPI; add immutable audit logs for EPI access (who / what / when), retained 6 years.
Remove third-party analytics scripts (e.g. Google Analytics) from any form collecting PHI.
No PHI to external LLMs — add a detection/redirection check; only self-hosted LLMs may process it.
TLS-encrypt treatment emails; keep explicit, immutable consent records.
Infra: encrypted buckets / RDS and end-to-end encryption between load balancer and internal services.
New limited-access "staff" role — hide clinical fields (messages, services, treatment/notes) from non-clinical users.
Exploring AI compliance tools (Vanta, Triumph.ai, Hugging Face models) to speed HIPAA / ISO readiness.

Engineering & architecture
Zenote / G-appointment architecture: multi-provider abstraction, booking-intent detection, role-based authorization (mask sensitive data for unauthorized roles, generate HIPAA audit events). To be aligned with existing third-party connectors.
Gia (J) response latency issue confirmed resolved in production.
Documentation started for API Gateway, Cognito, and authorization lambdas.

Operational
Automated end-of-day task-status collection via the AI group (6 PM message; mark done / not done).
